items.title: Unsloth Dynamic V3.1 GGUFs cut Qwen3.8-Flash-Next tokens ~50% with higher accuracy
items.summary: Unsloth shipped Dynamic V3.1 GGUFs for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next that match about 95% of full-precision thinking and token use. Versus same-size quants they report about 50% fewer tokens and 15% higher accuracy, with weights on Hugging Face and a local-run guide.

reception.summary: Builders report faster mid-session finishes and ask for MTP/MLX quants; Strata already includes the GGUFs. No Community Notes via API; no specific method pushback in the first 25 replies.

items.title: NaceAI publishes Drex technical report on foundation decision models
items.summary: NaceAI released a technical report on training its open Drex decision models with RLAF, including paper and product pages. Drex Max 1.1 and Drex for Finance stay closed for enterprise; open models remain on the Nace console.

items.title: Harness adapters: live RL LoRA training for Liquid LFM and Twil-9B agent tasks
items.summary: Hugging Face Harness Hub opened live RL training of LoRA adapters on Liquid LFM2.5/LFM3 and Twil-9B for agent tasks, with a public Space stream and blog. The run adds OpenCode alongside Hermes and Pi harnesses plus a Safeagents plugin against reward hacking.

items.title: WeirdML: Kimi K3.1 Pro scores 9.9%, ahead of Kimi-K3 but behind Haiku 5.5
items.summary: Independent WeirdML agentic benchmark run puts Kimi K3.1 Pro at 9.9% versus Kimi-K3 at 7.5%, still well behind Haiku 5.5. The run used the Kimi-code Fireworks provider.

items.title: TensorFold challenge: Qwen 3.8 27B +180.5% on DGX Spark, +81% on Apple Silicon
items.summary: Community TensorFold challenge finals for Qwen 3.8 27B report 180.5% faster on DGX Spark CUDA and 81% faster on Apple Silicon versus the challenge baseline, with anti-cheat notes for the next round.

items.title: LiteParse adds MiniCPM-OCR for layout-cropped document parsing
items.summary: LlamaIndex LiteParse can now call OpenBMB MiniCPM-OCR after layout cropping. On ParseBench the post says MiniCPM-OCR beats Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite and PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 on content faithfulness, with the integration on GitHub.

doubt.pushback: ParseBench claim is vendor-stated in the launch post; no third-party replication in this window.

items.title: PrunaAI P-Video-2-Pro-Replace: Rapidata human ratings, 3.2x cheaper and 1.6x faster
items.summary: Follow-up measurements for PrunaAI's person-swap video model: Rapidata human ratings place it within 3% of the top 480p model, about 3.2x cheaper ($0.05/s vs $0.16/s) and 1.6x faster than the next-fastest option, with API docs and P-Bench Space.

doubt.pushback: Vendor-reported Rapidata board with low engagement so far; prior product post already covered on Nov 5.
